title: TijarahJo Status Enums
description: Canonical status value definitions shared across frontend, backend, and database. Source of truth for all status-related logic.

PostStatus.description: Post lifecycle status. Deletion is handled by IsDeleted flag, NOT by a status value.

x-enum-descriptions.0: Post is publicly visible and available for purchase.
x-enum-descriptions.1: Post has been blocked by an admin and is not visible.
x-enum-descriptions.3: Post has been marked as sold by the owner.

UserStatus.description: User account status. Deletion is handled by IsDeleted flag, NOT by a status value.

x-enum-descriptions.1: User account is active and can log in.
x-enum-descriptions.2: User account has been banned by an admin.
